title: RightToWorkCredential
description: UK right-to-work status established by a certified DVS provider (demo). Exactly one credential per person. For demonstration only.

birthDate.description: Date of birth as a dateint (YYYYMMDD), so AnonCreds predicate proofs work without revealing the date

portrait.description: Portrait photo of the holder as a data URI

rtwEstablishedDate.description: Date the right to work was established (ISO 8601)

rtwExpiryDate.description: Expiry date of the right to work (ISO 8601); absent when the right to work does not expire
